title: Weightlifting makes older women leaner, stronger and more mobile | New Scientist
description: Lifting at least 50 kilograms twice a week improved older women's muscle mass, mobility and balance
author: Alice Klein

title: Quantum computing may be facing a replication crisis | New Scientist
description: A review of thousands of scientific papers about quantum computers finds that most don’t provide codes that can be tested on independent devices or that those codes don’t work
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: Rogue hacking AIs have changed the cybersecurity landscape | New Scientist
description: Attackers with no technical skills can now use AI models to find and exploit loopholes quickly and they can deploy them on a massive scale, raising fears that organisations without large budgets for cyber defence will be much more vulnerable
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Test moderators use AI-generated writing to judge literacy standards | New Scientist
description: To cut the cost of key stage 2 assessments, a UK government project proposes to use scripts generated by ChatGPT instead of real children's writing as examples supplied to moderators who check that grades are awarded fairly
author: Chris Stokel-Walker

title: THC in cannabis may reduce nightmares in people with PTSD | New Scientist
description: A drug made up of THC, the main psychoactive component of cannabis, reduced the severity and incidence of nightmares in people with PTSD
author: Mattha Busby

title: Fishers detonate a bomb every hour on one Indonesian coral reef | New Scientist
description: The use of explosives to kill fish is widespread across the tropics, and acoustic monitoring in an Indonesian archipelago detected more than 3500 explosions in 483 days
author: James Woodford
